mapper.sql: select g.id, g.group_no, g.title, g.country, g.expire_time, g.max_bindable, g.total_count, g.import_time, g.create_time, g.update_time, (select count(*) from tg_proxy_ip p where p.group_no = g.group_no and p.current_bind_count > 0 and p.status != 'disabled') as used_count, (select count(*) from tg_proxy_ip p where p.group_no = g.group_no and p.status = 'disabled') as disabled_count, (g.total_count - (select count(*) from tg_proxy_ip p where p.group_no = g.group_no and p.current_bind_count > 0 and p.status != 'disabled') - (select count(*) from tg_proxy_ip p where p.group_no = g.group_no and p.status = 'disabled')) as unused_count from tg_proxy_group g
mapper.insert: insert into tg_proxy_group (group_no, title, country, expire_time, max_bindable, total_count, import_time) values (#{groupNo}, #{title}, #{country}, #{expireTime}, #{maxBindable}, #{totalCount}, #{importTime})
mapper.delete:
delete from tg_proxy_group where id in
#{id}
